fields.name: LobbyIds
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1B7E0 (~ProcessLobbiesEvents, called from the TrackingSystem per-frame update bg3.exe+0x767AA0): clears the view's component at +0x50 with FUN_140E907E0 when its size (+0xC) is non-zero, then for each lobby-joined event appends the event's STDString with FUN_140E90A70 (stride 0x18, STDString copy). Toolkit: LobbyJoinedEvent from OnLobbyJoined(Result<LobbyJoinInfo>). Live: all zero (empty array).

open_questions: The string is presumably the joined lobby's id; content not observed
second_pass: Array<STDString> confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1B1B7E0 clears and appends to it through FUN_140E90A70, whose element stride is 0x18 with a STDString copy.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
